summary: The PR removes the post_init signal handler for ImageField when width_field and height_field are not set, which can improve performance. However, it lacks documentation and tests specifically addressing the removal of the signal handler.

issues.description: The PR does not include any additional tests to verify that removing the post_init signal handler does not affect the behavior of ImageField when width_field and height_field are not set.
The PR does not update the documentation to reflect the change in behavior regarding the post_init signal handler for ImageField.
